verification.basis: Existing research-mainline run and saved-data/geometry checks; no numerical rerun for this repository update.
verification.scope: Reference results from the research mainline. The repository paper-specific components and saved Grasshopper definition are separately versioned artifacts.

notes: All 936 sampled positions on the 72 discrete TNA edges passed the solid-containment check; this is a sampled check.
CrownFilletRadius is 0.20 m for N6, rather than the 0.30 m used by H0-H3.
The first candidate to complete the full mainline was retained; pressure and sliding-deficit magnitudes were not selection thresholds.
The raw sampled volume was approximately 1.46% above exact volume before exact-volume rescaling. Local load-allocation convergence was not established.
Section warnings, opening/partial contact and one positive-deficit joint remain. Numerical completion does not establish structural safety.
Maximum pressure and maximum sliding deficit occur at different joints and directions; they do not form one simultaneous load case.
The research run also executed the legacy empirical-capacity and dowel stages. Those stages are outside this repository publication scope; their outputs are not included here.
